narration_ml: Section 115BAC default tax regime-ൽ Resident Individuals-ന്റെ Total Income-നാണ് നിശ്ചിത slab rates പ്രകാരം നികുതി കണക്കാക്കുന്നത്. ഈ ഘടനയാണ് ബാധകമായ regime വ്യക്തമാക്കുന്നത്.

card.title: Default Regime Scope
lines: Section 115BAC sets the default-regime tax rules.
The narration identifies Resident Individuals for the described rebate rules.
Tax is computed on Total Income using the applicable slabs.
card.review_flag: REVIEW REQUIRED: provisions.json shows slabs beginning at ₹ 3,00,000 and omits the narration values; the narration states slabs beginning at ₹ 4,00,000 and rebate threshold/amount ₹ 12,00,000 / ₹ 60,000. Confirm against the question bank PDF.

narration_ml: Section 87A rebate Resident Individuals-ന് മാത്രമാണ്; eligibility Total Income threshold, അതിനുള്ള statutory conditions എന്നിവ അനുസരിച്ചാണ് തീരുമാനിക്കുന്നത്.

card.title: Section 87A Eligibility
lines: The narration limits the rebate to Resident Individuals.
Eligibility depends on the applicable Total Income threshold.
Apply Section 87A after computing income-tax under the relevant regime.
card.review_flag: REVIEW REQUIRED: provisions.json shows slabs beginning at ₹ 3,00,000 and omits the narration values; the narration states slabs beginning at ₹ 4,00,000 and rebate threshold/amount ₹ 12,00,000 / ₹ 60,000. Confirm against the question bank PDF.

narration_ml: Narration-consistent slab schedule-ൽ ₹ 4,00,000 വരെ Nil ആണ്; ₹ 4,00,001 മുതൽ ₹ 12,00,000 വരെയുള്ള slabs-ൽ 5%, 10% നിരക്കുകൾ ബാധകമാണ്.

card.title: Initial Tax Slabs
lines: Income up to ₹ 4,00,000 is taxed at Nil rate.
Income from ₹ 4,00,001 to ₹ 8,00,000 is taxed at 5%.
Income from ₹ 8,00,001 to ₹ 12,00,000 is taxed at 10%.
card.review_flag: REVIEW REQUIRED: provisions.json shows slabs beginning at ₹ 3,00,000 and omits the narration values; the narration states slabs beginning at ₹ 4,00,000 and rebate threshold/amount ₹ 12,00,000 / ₹ 60,000. Confirm against the question bank PDF.

card.title: Upper Tax Slabs
lines: Income from ₹ 12,00,001 to ₹ 16,00,000 is taxed at 15%.
Income above ₹ 24,00,000 is taxed at 30%.
card.review_flag: REVIEW REQUIRED: provisions.json shows slabs beginning at ₹ 3,00,000 and omits the narration values; the narration states slabs beginning at ₹ 4,00,000 and rebate threshold/amount ₹ 12,00,000 / ₹ 60,000. Confirm against the question bank PDF.

narration_ml: Narration-consistent rule പ്രകാരം Resident Individual-ന്റെ Total Income ₹ 12,00,000 കവിയാത്താൽ Section 87A പ്രകാരം ₹ 60,000 വരെയുള്ള നികുതി rebate ആയി ലഭിക്കും.

card.title: Full Rebate Threshold
lines: Available to Resident Individuals under Section 87A.
The stated Total Income threshold is ₹ 12,00,000.
The narration states a maximum rebate of ₹ 60,000.
card.review_flag: REVIEW REQUIRED: provisions.json shows slabs beginning at ₹ 3,00,000 and omits the narration values; the narration states slabs beginning at ₹ 4,00,000 and rebate threshold/amount ₹ 12,00,000 / ₹ 60,000. Confirm against the question bank PDF.

narration_ml: Income ₹ 12,00,000 കവിയുമ്പോൾ slab tax-ഉം ₹ 12,00,000-ന് മുകളിലുള്ള അധിക വരുമാനവും താരതമ്യം ചെയ്ത് marginal relief കണക്കാക്കണം.

card.title: Marginal Relief Test
lines: Apply when Total Income exceeds the ₹ 12,00,000 threshold.
Compare slab tax with income exceeding the threshold.
Relief limits tax before cess to the excess income amount.
card.review_flag: REVIEW REQUIRED: provisions.json shows slabs beginning at ₹ 3,00,000 and omits the narration values; the narration states slabs beginning at ₹ 4,00,000 and rebate threshold/amount ₹ 12,00,000 / ₹ 60,000. Confirm against the question bank PDF.

narration_ml: Marginal relief-ന്റെ ലക്ഷ്യം threshold-നെ അല്പം കവിയുന്ന വരുമാനത്തിന് അധിക വരുമാനത്തേക്കാൾ കൂടുതലായ നികുതി വരുന്നത് തടയുന്നതാണ്. ഇതാണ് relief-ന്റെ പ്രധാന പരിധി.

card.title: Marginal Relief Limit
lines: Tax before cess cannot exceed the income above the threshold.
Compare the calculated slab tax with that excess income.
The lower amount is the tax payable before cess under the stated formula.
card.review_flag: REVIEW REQUIRED: provisions.json shows slabs beginning at ₹ 3,00,000 and omits the narration values; the narration states slabs beginning at ₹ 4,00,000 and rebate threshold/amount ₹ 12,00,000 / ₹ 60,000. Confirm against the question bank PDF.

narration_ml: Marginal relief കണക്കാക്കിയ ശേഷമുള്ള tax-ൽ മാത്രമേ 4% Health and Education Cess ചേർക്കാവൂ; relief-ന് മുമ്പ് cess കണക്കാക്കരുത്.

card.title: Apply Cess Last
lines: Health and Education Cess is charged at 4%.
Calculate it on tax after marginal relief.
Do not add cess before determining the marginal-relief amount.
